statement.detailedDescription:
I am writing to dispute a charge of $8.00 USD from 'Cloud Services Inc' that appeared on my statement dated January 28, 2026. I have thoroughly reviewed my recent purchases, subscriptions, and any online services I might use, and I cannot find any record or memory of authorizing this specific transaction or signing up for any service from a company named 'Cloud Services Inc'. I do not recognize this merchant at all.

I am usually very careful about my online subscriptions and track all my recurring payments. This charge is completely unfamiliar to me. I have not provided my card details to any cloud service provider recently, nor have I initiated any trial subscriptions that might have auto-renewed under this merchant name. The amount is small, but the merchant name is completely foreign, which leads me to believe this is an unauthorized charge.

I genuinely have no recollection of engaging with 'Cloud Services Inc' in any capacity. I am confident that this transaction was not authorized by me, and I am requesting a full investigation and reversal of this charge.
statement.requestedResolution: Credit for the disputed amount ($8.00 USD).
statement.cardholderDeclaration: I declare that the information provided in this statement is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge and belief.

bankInternalNotes.riskAssessment: Low risk for systemic fraud; appears to be a genuine instance of a cardholder not recognizing a specific, likely small, transaction. No immediate red flags for compromised card details.
bankInternalNotes.recommendedAction: Proceed with chargeback under Mastercard Reason Code 4863. Advise cardholder to monitor future statements for similar unrecognized charges.
